title: Decision of the AI Office
summary: The Decision of the AI Office outlines the official stance and guidelines regarding AI usage within the organization. It provides directives on compliance, risk management, and best practices for AI implementation.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Technology Specialists in AI
summary: This policy outlines the recruitment and responsibilities of technology specialists required to manage and support AI initiatives within the organization. It details the qualifications, job duties, and the importance of these roles in ensuring effective AI deployment.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Lead Scientific Adviser
summary: This policy describes a new position for a Lead Scientific Adviser in the AI office. It outlines the adviser’s role in shaping research priorities, ensuring compliance with AI guidelines, and guiding the department’s strategic direction.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Legal Officers
summary: This document announces a vacancy for legal officer positions in an AI-focused office, outlining the required qualifications, duties, and application process. It highlights the importance of legal expertise in overseeing AI projects to ensure compliance with ethical standards and regulatory requirements.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Policy Officers
summary: This policy explains how to handle open positions for AI policy officers in the organization. It outlines the procedures for finding, hiring, and supporting new officers to ensure continuous leadership in AI governance.

title: AI Act Scientific Panel
summary: The AI Act Scientific Panel is a group of experts who review and advise on the AI Act, ensuring that scientific evidence and research inform the law’s creation and implementation. They aim to balance innovation with safety and societal impact by providing objective, evidence‑based guidance to regulators.

title: Draft Standardisation Request
summary: This document is a formal request to create standardized guidelines for AI systems. It proposes establishing consistent rules to improve safety, fairness, and transparency across AI development and deployment.

title: CoP Consultation Notice
summary: The CoP Consultation Notice is an announcement inviting stakeholders to share their thoughts and feedback on the proposed Community of Practice (CoP) policy. It outlines the purpose, consultation period, and how participants can submit their input to help shape the policy.

title: CoP Call for Expression of Interest
summary: This policy invites individuals and organizations to express interest in joining or forming a Community of Practice (CoP) focused on AI policy. Participants are encouraged to submit expressions of interest so that the CoP can build a collaborative network for sharing best practices and advancing responsible AI development.

title: CoP Graphic: Overview of Iterative Drafting Process
summary: This document presents a graphic illustrating the iterative drafting process used by a Community of Practice. It outlines how drafts are refined through repeated cycles of feedback, revisions, and stakeholder input to improve clarity and effectiveness.

title: CoP Graphic: Timeline of Drafting Process
summary: This policy outlines the chronological stages of drafting the Community of Practice (CoP) graphic, detailing the sequence of development from initial conception to final approval. It serves as a visual timeline that helps stakeholders track progress and key milestones throughout the drafting process.

title: Code of Practice: 1st Draft
summary: This document outlines an initial set of guidelines for responsible AI use, including principles for transparency, fairness, and accountability. It serves as a foundational framework to help organizations adopt best practices while mitigating risks associated with AI deployment.

title: Code of Practice: 2nd Draft
summary: This document is a second draft of a Code of Practice, providing updated guidelines for responsible use and management of AI systems. It sets out expectations and best practices for organizations, developers, and users to ensure safe, ethical, and compliant AI deployment.

title: Code of Practice: 3rd Draft
summary: This Code of Practice outlines best practices for responsible AI use, covering areas such as transparency, accountability, and ethical considerations. It aims to guide organizations in implementing safe and fair AI systems through clear standards and guidelines.

title: AI Pact Draft
summary: The AI Pact Draft proposes a framework for responsible AI development and deployment, setting shared standards for safety, transparency, and accountability. It calls for collaboration among governments, industry, and civil society to ensure AI benefits society while mitigating risks.

title: AI Pact Final
summary: The AI Pact Final is a comprehensive agreement that outlines principles and guidelines for the development, deployment, and regulation of artificial intelligence technologies. It aims to promote responsible AI use, ensuring safety, transparency, and fairness while fostering collaboration between stakeholders worldwide.

title: Guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices
summary: This policy outlines specific AI activities that are disallowed, clarifying which practices must be avoided. It offers guidance for developers and users to ensure compliance and prevent potentially harmful or unethical AI use.

title: Guidelines on AI System Definition
summary: The policy explains how to define an AI system, outlining the key characteristics that make a system qualify as AI. It provides guidelines for identifying and classifying such systems so they can be properly managed and regulated.

title: Communication on Boosting Start-Ups & Innovation
summary: The policy aims to strengthen how information and ideas are shared to support the growth of start‑ups and stimulate innovative activity. It outlines strategies for improving communication, collaboration, and knowledge exchange so that new businesses can access resources, networks, and insights that accelerate their development.

title: EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups
summary: The EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups is a European program that offers high‑performance computing resources and technical support to new and emerging businesses. It aims to help startups accelerate research, development, and innovation in science, engineering, and technology fields.

title: Slideshow: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: A slideshow webinar titled “Risk Management” provides an overview of strategies and best practices for identifying, assessing, and mitigating potential risks. It covers how organizations can implement effective risk management frameworks to ensure safe and responsible AI deployment.

title: Video: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This webinar video explains the fundamentals of risk management and how to identify and mitigate potential risks. It covers best practices, real-world examples, and offers practical tools for managing risk in various contexts.
